description: This file defines benchmark classes for tensor concatenation operations using PyTorch, including configurations, memory workload calculations, and registration of benchmark classes.

classes.name: Concat2D2InputBench
classes.description: Benchmark class for 2D concatenation of two inputs with various configurations.

classes.name: ConcatGraphOptBench
classes.description: Benchmark class for optimized graph concatenation with additional fusion and relu operations.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs concatenation of inputs after adding a small value.

methods.name: reference
methods.description: Provides a numpy-based reference implementation of concatenation.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns configuration parameters for the benchmark.

methods.name: module
methods.description: Returns the module name for the benchmark.

methods.name: memory_workload
methods.description: Calculates memory workload based on input sizes and mode.

methods.name: default_configs
methods.description: Provides default configuration sets for the benchmarks.
